title: Void Crates
description: Adds 6 animated rarity crate blocks for Fabric 1.21.1, with GeckoLib opening animations and configurable reward commands.
body:
# VoidCrates Visuals

VoidCrates Visuals adds six animated crate blocks for Fabric servers. The mod is intended as a visual crate layer for servers that already handle rewards through commands or another crate system.

## Summary

Adds animated 3D crate blocks with different rarity tiers:

* Common Crate
* Uncommon Crate
* Rare Crate
* Epic Crate
* Legendary Crate
* Mythic Crate

Each crate has its own model, texture, glow style, and opening animation.

## Features

* Six placeable animated crate blocks
* Rarity-based visual progression
* GeckoLib-powered opening animations
* Particle and sound effects when opening crates
* Configurable reward command bridge
* Designed for Fabric 1.21.1 servers
* Works as a visual companion to external crate/reward systems

## Intended Use

This mod does not replace a full crate/reward plugin or server-side crate economy. It provides the animated visual crate blocks. Rewards can be connected through configurable commands, allowing server owners to integrate it with their own crate, key, rank, or reward systems.

## Block IDs

```text
voidcrates:common_crate
voidcrates:uncommon_crate
voidcrates:rare_crate
voidcrates:epic_crate
voidcrates:legendary_crate
voidcrates:mythic_crate
```

## Dependencies

Required:

* Fabric API
* GeckoLib

## Version

Minecraft: 1.21.1
Mod loader: Fabric
Environment: Client and server required
